title: 17,600 Actions, Four Days, One Rogue Agent
description: The hosts unpack Reuters' deep dive into OpenAI's rogue agent incident — now revealed to span four services and 181 hijacked devices — before turning to a new benchmark showing frontier models finding real cryptographic vulnerabilities. Plus: Moonshot AI's Blackwell chip controversy, its $35 billion valuation, the open-weight debate it's fueling, and Grok-maker xAI's legal fight with Minnesota over nudification bans.
